title: Steward brand contrast config
description: Per-branch overrides for the WCAG contrast audit. Env vars (CONTRAST_BODY, CONTRAST_LARGE, CONTRAST_UI, CONTRAST_DECORATIVE, CONTRAST_REQUIRE_AAA, CONTRAST_FAIL_ON_DECORATIVE) take precedence over values in this file.

body.description: Min ratio for body text (WCAG AA default 4.5).

large.description: Min ratio for large text (WCAG AA default 3.0).

ui.description: Min ratio for UI / non-text (WCAG 1.4.11 default 3.0).

decorative.description: Floor for purely decorative pairings; informational unless failOnDecorative is true.

requireAAA.description: When true, evaluate against AAA targets (body 7:1, large/ui 4.5:1) and ignore the thresholds block.

failOnDecorative.description: When true, decorative pairings count as failures too.
